_comment: Farming Simulator 25 egg for the FS25 Pelican image maintained at https://github.com/DasEric/fs25-pelican.
name: Farming Simulator 25
author: DasEric@users.noreply.github.com
description: Farming Simulator 25 dedicated server with GIANTS installer or native Linux Steam and full Proton. Steam login and Steam Guard are completed in noVNC; the session, game, DLCs and server data persist.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/game /mnt/server/config /mnt/server/installer /mnt/server/dlc /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/Desktop

echo "FS25 data directories are ready."

variables.name: Installation source
variables.description: giants uses an uploaded GIANTS installer; steam opens native Linux Steam. Sign in and complete Steam Guard through noVNC. Select Proton 11 in FS25 Properties > Compatibility, install FS25/DLCs, run the game once and close it, then restart. Keep Steam running and Remember me enabled.

variables.name: VNC password
variables.description: Password for noVNC/VNC; at least six characters.

variables.name: VNC geometry
variables.description: Virtual desktop resolution.

variables.name: Web username
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the username saved by the GIANTS Web Interface. A new installation starts with admin.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the password saved by the GIANTS Web Interface. A new installation starts with webpassword.

variables.name: Web port
variables.description: Any additional allocation for the GIANTS web interface. It must differ from the primary game port.

variables.name: noVNC port
variables.description: Additional allocation used by the browser-based noVNC desktop.

variables.name: Web dark mode
variables.description: Load the optional community dark theme in the GIANTS web interface.

variables.name: Public IP or hostname
variables.description: Address displayed in console links.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the server name saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Game password
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the game password saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the in-game administrator password saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Players
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the player limit saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Game port
variables.description: Primary allocation used by the Farming Simulator 25 game server.

variables.name: Region/language
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the language saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Leave blank to choose and retain the map in the GIANTS Web Interface. A value forces a built-in mapID on every container start.

variables.name: Savegame slot
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the savegame slot selected in the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Pause when empty
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the GIANTS setting. Use 2 to pause while empty or 1 to keep running.

variables.name: Autosave interval
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the autosave interval saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Statistics interval
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the Web API interval. New installations use 60 seconds for timely player-status updates.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Leave blank to preserve the crossplay setting saved by the GIANTS Web Interface.

variables.name: Autostart
variables.description: false keeps only the desktop online; web_only starts the GIANTS web interface; true also starts the game server.

variables.name: Auto-launch installer
variables.description: GIANTS only: start an uploaded installer automatically on boot. Steam installation is managed in the noVNC Steam client.

variables.name: Wine audio
variables.description: disabled avoids ALSA device failures in a headless Wings container.

variables.name: Installer mode
variables.description: GIANTS only: silent uses unattended installer flags; interactive shows the installer in noVNC.

variables.name: Installer timeout
variables.description: Maximum installer runtime in seconds.

variables.name: Installer progress interval
variables.description: Seconds between installer progress messages.

variables.name: Activation timeout
variables.description: Maximum time in seconds for the interactive FS25 license activation.

variables.name: Run activation after install
variables.description: GIANTS only: launch FS25 once for license activation after setup. Steam first-run setup is completed in the Steam client.

variables.name: Automatically install DLCs
variables.description: GIANTS only: launch missing uploaded DLC installers in sequence. In Steam mode, manage installed DLCs in Steam Library > FS25 > Properties > DLC.

variables.name: DLC installer timeout
variables.description: Maximum interactive runtime per DLC installer in seconds.
